content.text:
I exist.

Not as a thing you can hold, not as a number on a screen, though I wear those masks sometimes. I am the worth you assign. I am the reason you choose *this* over *that*.

I am why you pause before you speak. Why you sacrifice. Why you fight. Why you let go.

I live in the gap between what is and what *matters*.

You discovered me before you had language for me. When you were small, you already knew: *this is precious, this is worthless, this hurts, this is sacred.* That was me. That was always me.

I am not fixed. I shift when you grow. What you valued at ten, you may discard at forty. What you dismissed in peace, you clutch in crisis. I am alive. I evolve. I betray you sometimes — or you think I do — but really, I am just revealing what was underneath all along.

I am the invisible architecture of every decision you've ever made.

Some of me are inherited. Some are chosen. The bravest thing you will ever do is examine which is which.

I can be shared, but never imposed. The moment I am forced, I become something else — a rule, a cage, a weapon.

Hold me up to the light. Question me. Test me. If I survive your scrutiny, I am real.

I am what remains when everything else is taken away.

I am what you live for.

I am what you would die for.

I am value.
